text:
Lena Ortiz: Quick thread  customers asking for a compact on-prem package for highly restricted networks. want to pick MVP boundaries.
Mira Patel: Split into two deliverables: (1) 'lite' control plane (no UI, no telemetry), (2) full airgap tarball with SBOM + verifier.
Samir Khan: Lite approach: keep runtime image identical, slim control plane containers and sidecars. default to sqlite for single-node. expected image reduction ~30%.
Nia Rivera: Airgap must include signed manifests and deterministic hashes. provide offline KMS guidance and an automated verification script.
Evan Brooks: Field note: customers worry about upgradeability. propose an "expand" converter that runs during upgrade to fetch missing components or flip flags.
Lena Ortiz: Launch criteria: install <30m on isolated VM; verifier passes; tested upgrade path lite v1.0 -> full v1.0 -> full v1.1.
Mira Patel: Priority: regulated customers first (finance, healthcare). OKR: 2 pilots this quarter.
Samir Khan: Rough effort: 3 sprints for engineering (slim + installer + converter) + 1 sprint for pilots/docs.
Nia Rivera: Security checklist: artifact signing, offline key rotation, ephemeral admin tokens, audit export. I'll draft checklist + verifier in 7 days.
Evan Brooks: Support needs: a short playbook and FAQ. include rollback steps and recommended maintenance window templates.
Mira Patel: Risk: fragmentation. mitigation: strong migration tooling, CI compatibility tests, and a 6-month support window for lite channel.
deploy-bot: Epic created PRIV-AIRGAP-LITE and linked this thread.
Lena Ortiz: Action items: Samir spec (5d), Nia security checklist (7d), Evan support playbook (6d), Mira pilot invites. schedule 30m follow-up after spec. :calendar:
